analysis: Price is probing the 83,800 VAH despite heavy aggressive perpetual selling, pointing to passive spot absorption of derivative short flow. A failure by sellers to force price back inside the value area risks a leverage squeeze higher, while a dip below VAH favors a quick rotation to POC.
